subject: Helping NomadGo scale vision AI like Standard AI & Focal Systems
text:
Hi [NAME],

Congrats on NomadGo's deployment in Starbucks (as a religious drinker, a
heartfelt thank you for making life easier for the baristas behind the
scenes!) Thought I'd reach out since we work with Standard AI & Focal
Systems on building similar CV models for retail use cases.

faster and easier to annotate complex training data for SKU recognition,
inventory management and customer behaviour prediction.

Quick context about Encord: we're a data development platform for advanced
computer vision and multimodal AI (image, video etc). We bring together
data curation, annotation, workflow management & model evaluation into one
place, so teams can focus on building better AI models instead of wrestling
with data.

Would love to get your candid feedback on what we're building. Do you have
20 mins to chat? Wed/Thu work best for us.

subject: AI Dash Cam - video annotation
text:
Hi [NAME],

Congrats on the launch of GOFocus Plus - excited to see [COMPANY]'s AI dash
cam reducing risky driver behaviours. With these new features, I imagine
scaling video annotation and surfacing the most relevant samples for model
development is becoming even more critical.

Motive Technologies recently chose Encord for a very similar video
intelligence/ driver safety use case. A few ways they benefited and where
we could help [COMPANY]:

   - Pipeline automation (e.g. VLM-assisted auto-labelling, SAM2-enabled
   detection, segmentation & tracking)
   - Integrated data curation and annotation saving engineering teams from
   building integrations

Would you be open to a 30-min chat on how we can help [COMPANY]? I'm flexible
morning times ET.

subject: Couterfeit detection accuracy
text:
Hi [NAME],

Congrats on your Series B! I saw expanding your AI team is a key focus from
the fundraise, so I want to introduce myself as your point of contact at
Encord - a computer vision platform to streamline annotation/
human-in-the-loop workflows.

We've supported teams like GumGum, DoubleVerify, and Zefr, whom similar to
MarqVision train content verification models on large volume of social
media /marketplace images from the web. With Encord, they've increased
annotation efficiency by 60% and reduced model false positive rate from 6%
to 1%.

We mainly help automating manual annotation with LLM/VLM so human experts
can focus on edge cases - e.g. when logos or trademarks are partially
obscured or contextually ambiguous. This reduces engineering overhead and
accelerates product iteration cycles.

Would you be open to a quick chat to explore if we can help your AI team
scale more efficiently? I'm flexible morning times PT.
